content.text: {"id": "mm6438a4", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed death data from the National Vital Statistics System"}, {"loc": "summary", "q": "The total estimated lifetime medical and work-loss costs associated with fatal injuries in 2013 was $214 billion."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "continuous", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The mean medical and work-loss cost of any injury death in 2013 was slightly more than $1.1 million"}]}, {"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "During 2013, the rate of fatal injury was 61.0 per 100,000 population"}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Males accounted for approximately 78% of these costs and for 67% of injury deaths."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Males accounted for 78% of economic costs ($166.7 billion)."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Persons aged 15–44 years accounted for 82% of homicide-associated costs, compared with 65% and 64%"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cost/economic", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Cost of injury estimates were updated using improved methodology and the most recently available injury data."}]}, {"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed death data from the National Vital Statistics System"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Injury death rates were calculated using the U.S. Census Bureau's bridged race population estimates for 2013."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The sex- and age-specific probability of surviving to a given age was multiplied by the mean earnings of persons of that sex and age"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "assuming that no one would live beyond age 102 years"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Cost estimates were computed from average lifetime work-loss and medical costs by mechanism and intent of injury."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": ["analytic_depth"]}
